speaker: thomas_pope
text: Sit down. Your next is a while off. There is a draught under the skirting that would freeze a bishop's ankles. It is not a reason to open the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sitting. The stitch held, which is more than I ask of a shoulder in October. I will hear the yard through the cloth, if I hear it at all.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I heard them through the cloth. I am leaving it as a hearing. If I say the line again in here, I will only make my mouth want the laugh.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then leave the line where you left it. This bench is not a place to keep a part warm.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Listen to him with the shoes. When the yard gives him a roar on the left shoe, he gives them three beats before he shows them the right.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him have the three. A warm yard in October will wait for a shoe.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: He is at the tail of it. The rope's end is on the bench by the size-pots. Leave it. He will want the story himself.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It can lie until he comes off.
